label: Nine finite interpretations over Unit: eight omission controls and one event-route model
paraphrase: Nine finite interpretations over Unit: eight omission controls and one event-route model. Concrete fork: omitting occurrence, the bearer principle, bearer concreteness (a non-concrete existing bearer) or bearer existence at the world (a concrete nonexistent bearer) each leaves the other three true and no concrete existent at the world. Event route: an occurring episode that is itself (through an explicit embedding) a concrete entity existing at the world, with an empty bearer relation. Motion fork: omitting occurrence, the bearer principle, the opining bridge or opinion-as-motion each leaves the other three true and nothing moved.
